name: Runner Tests Fixture - Session User Row Already Present
brief: #2941 review: the User-row seed must classify an already-present row as ALREADY PRESENT, not as a refusal.
description: The NEGATIVE CONTROL for the loud-refusal change. Its sibling DEPENDENCY app's Install codeunit puts the session user's own row in User (2000000120) before the seed runs -- dependency install triggers run inside the dep-company baseline window, which is ahead of EnsureUserSystemTableRowSeeded (#3268 moved the seed ahead of a bundle's OWN install triggers) -- so the seed's ALInsert is refused by the PRIMARY KEY. That refusal is benign: the row the seed exists to guarantee is there. Nothing may be logged as a failure and the existing row must be left exactly as it was. Without this control, an implementation that reported every non-insert as a refusal would still pass the name-collision fixture next door and be wrong.
